as_told.title: Minot AFB bomber encounters a saucer
as_told.place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

plain: In 1968 a UFO is said to have appeared at Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota, and it was caught on radar. Michels says this himself, in a debate with a skeptic: "we actually have radar associated with it and physicists have reviewed the radar," among them a physicist named Kevin Knuth. An online researcher known as UAPGerb tells it more loosely. He says a bomber, which he calls a B-2, "encountered a saucer flying around it", and he gives no year. Michels brings up the case because radar would be hard evidence, not just what people say they saw.
